description: Machine-readable schema for AER-1 (AI Agent Execution Receipt), draft-zambo-aer1-02, Section 3. The core members are required; deployed records MAY carry additional members, and a verifier MUST NOT require them.

canonical_bytes.description: Base64 encoding of the exact UTF-8 bytes hashed for the output commitment.

output_hash.description: "sha256:" followed by the lowercase hex digest of the decoded canonical_bytes.

provenance_class.description: Exactly one provenance class (Section 5). The first label names the recording system; another implementation substitutes its own system name. The second and third labels are fixed strings.

receipt_schema_version.description: Schema version. "0.3" in the reference implementation.

tool.description: Names the tool: name, version, and caller scope.

verification_status.description: "verified" when the stored record passes the Section 6 procedure.

title: AER-1 Execution Receipt
